hooks.command: case "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" in *'git commit'*) go run ./cmd/agnostic-ai sync --check || { echo 'specs drift from emitted files; run: agnostic-ai sync' >&2; exit 1; } ;; esac
case "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" in *'git commit'*) go test ./... ;; esac
echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS" | tr ' ' '\n' | grep '\.go$' | xargs -r -I{} dirname {} | sort -u | xargs -r -I{} go vet ./{}/...
